name: P-015 R-3 live-plane observation on the STAGING operator (2026-09-26): ideate on/off stack transition served by :3170 7d787f2c51, desired->prepared->applied receipts, coord:orient leaves a pending activation for turn-start (WI-10002717), actor/principal stability, per-layer span join

commandBasis: Copied from the drill script and the read-only query file it generated beside its outputs (timeline .papercusp/scratch/r7/r3-drill-wi10003169e/timeline.txt, results q-all.txt). The script's own psql -f call failed with "Permission denied" (the postgres role cannot read a file under the observer's home), so the unedited q-all.sql was re-run read-only on stdin. The generated window 2026-09-26T16:20:10Z - 2026-09-26T16:21:32Z was used as written: v5 rounds the window end up, so no bound was corrected.
timeBasis: startedAt is the :3170 /api/health read that opened the drill (sha 7d787f2c51); finishedAt is the drill's own done stamp. The drill window used by q-all.sql is 2026-09-26T16:20:10Z - 2026-09-26T16:21:32Z. Snapshots use database clock_timestamp() between steps.
summary: Doc 2026-09-24d (build 6f2044817d) predates a change to measured R-3 source path(s) packages/operator-core/lib/capability-envelope/identity-grants-port.ts 150edc7d8d->f5ddd86ef4, packages/operator-core/lib/identity-management.ts a21a5e1b59->4841744c8f, so its bindings went freshness-stale. This drill ran the same ideate on/off transition through :3170 at 7d787f2c51, whose four R-3 source blobs equal canonical HEAD and the working tree. Each transition first called coord:orient {afterCompaction}; both times orient returned ok and the activation stayed pending (status desired, delivered watermark not advanced). The turn-start boundary then wrote prepared and applied. Enabling ideate produced generation 23 (desired 21418, prepared 21419, applied 21420) and disabling it produced generation 24 (21421 / 21423 / 21424). Every event carries actor == owner, principal system:superuser and adv session 30758. The gen-23 activation opened 2 layer spans, including ideation:su.mode-ideate, closed exactly when gen 24 applied; gen 24 opened 1 without ideation. All seven drill tool calls were served by port-3170 at 7d787f2c51.

subject.note: The observer's own psu session. The transient ideate overlay was enabled and disabled within 82 seconds purely as a stack transition to observe; the session's AUTO mode was unchanged throughout.

sourceBlobs.basis: git rev-parse <ref>:<path>; identical in 7d787f2c51 (the papercusp-staging checkout :3170 serves), canonical HEAD d50ecedc30 and the working tree

replication.sql: \pset footer off \echo === q-activation (events > baseline 21417, drill window 2026-09-26T16:20:10Z - 2026-09-26T16:21:32Z) SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, e.id, e.control_generation AS gen, e.phase, e.source, e.stack_refs, left(e.specification_revision,12) AS spec, left(e.state_revision,12) AS state, e.adv_session_id AS adv, e.actor_id = e.owner_id AS actor_is_owner, e.principal_id, e.failure, e.recorded_at FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events e WHERE e.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND e.owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b' AND e.id > 21417 AND e.recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-26T16:20:10Z' AND '2026-09-26T16:21:32Z' ORDER BY e.id; SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, control_generation, control_delivered_generation, control_state->'activation'->>'status' AS status FROM harness_shared.session_briefs WHERE owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace'; \echo === q-spans (spans opened by the drill applied events) SELECT count(*) AS span_count_now FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b'; SELECT activation_event_id, control_generation, actor_id, principal_id, layer_slot, layer_ref, active_from, active_until FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b' AND activation_event_id IN (SELECT id FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events WHERE owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND id > 21417 AND phase='applied' AND recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-26T16:20:10Z' AND '2026-09-26T16:21:32Z') ORDER BY activation_event_id, layer_slot; \echo === q-serving (tool calls served inside the drill window) SELECT id, tool_name, status, serving_host, serving_build_sha, invoked_at FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE id > 29709360 AND coord_owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b' AND invoked_at BETWEEN '2026-09-26T16:20:10Z' AND '2026-09-26T16:21:32Z' ORDER BY id; \echo === q-usage (usage samples attributed to the drill activations) SELECT id, to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) AS at, source, model_class, session_id, identity_activation_event_id, identity_owner_id FROM harness_shared.agent_usage_samples_identity_attribution WHERE ts BETWEEN (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-26T16:20:10Z')*1000)::bigint AND (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-26T16:21:32Z')*1000)::bigint AND (identity_owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b' OR session_id ILIKE '%38e71009%' OR identity_activation_event_id IN (SELECT id FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events WHERE owner_id='su-bd59a9cc-f5fe-4f3f-959a-3077528e4f1b' AND id > 21417 AND phase='applied')) ORDER BY id;

replication.note: re-running it performs a new transient ideate on/off transition for the invoking owner; it captures fresh id floors and regenerates q-all.sql for its own window

assertions.evidence: Served by :3170 7d787f2c51. mode:set ideate=on (16:20:11.111Z-16:20:18.613Z) wrote 21418 desired gen 23 (spec a9a2f4fe84d5, state 8696e0f4fa9b, stack autonomy:su.mode-auto + ideation:su.mode-ideate). The turn-start boundary (16:20:27.923Z-16:20:30.311Z) then wrote 21419 prepared and 21420 applied with the same revision pair. mode:set ideate=off wrote 21421 desired gen 24 (spec a9a2f4fe84d5, state 6d031da47dd3, stack autonomy:su.mode-auto); its turn-start (16:20:37.952Z-16:21:04.152Z) wrote 21423 prepared and 21424 applied. session_briefs after each turn-start: 23/23 applied, then 24/24 applied.

WI-10002717 live check on the new build. Before each turn-start the drill called coord:orient {afterCompaction:true} through :3170 (16:20:18.989Z-16:20:27.790Z and 16:20:32.664Z-16:20:37.853Z). Both returned ok:true. The snapshots straight after them read generation/delivered/status 23/22/desired (2026-09-26 12:20:27.899179-04) and 24/23/desired (2026-09-26 12:20:37.94528-04): the delivery watermark was NOT advanced and the activation stayed pending until the turn-start boundary.

All six events carry actor_id == owner_id, principal_id system:superuser and adv_session_id 30758, with no failure. The 3 spans opened by 21420/21424 carry the same actor and principal. The transition did not re-attribute the session.

session_identity_layer_spans for the owner: activation 21420 (gen 23) opened 2 spans (autonomy:su.mode-auto, ideation:su.mode-ideate), active 2026-09-26 12:20:28.000556-04 - 2026-09-26 12:20:38.456825-04. Activation 21424 (gen 24) opened 1 (autonomy:su.mode-auto) from 2026-09-26 12:20:38.456825-04, still open at read time, with no ideation span. The ideation layer is attributable to exactly the 10-second window its activation was applied. Usage join (usage-attribution.txt, read 2026-09-26T16:25:23.377Z): no sample has joined onto a drill activation yet.

tool_invocations for the owner in 2026-09-26T16:20:10Z - 2026-09-26T16:21:32Z: all seven drill calls (mode:set x2, coord:orient x2, state:read x2, work_items:get) carry serving_host port-3170 and serving_build_sha 7d787f2c51, as do the reads coord:orient fans out to (coord:inbox, coord:plan-events, coord:whoami, fleet:assignments, work_items:list, work_items:observe). The 5 non-3170 rows in the window are the observer session's own concurrent calls (capability:bash, activity:report, capability:bash_output); none is a mode or activation write.

The :3170 turn-start-memory responses carried both payloads. 12 (after ideate on): ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ reason next-generation, generations 22->23, with ⟦stack⟧ attach ops for ideation. It is a delta, not a full resync, because the delivered watermark equalled the generation at drill start (snapshot 00-baseline 22/22/applied), so the pending transition's previousGeneration 22 matched it; decideControlTransitionDelivery (control-anchor.ts) delivers the delta in that case. 17 (after ideate off): ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ reason next-generation, 23->24, with a ⟦stack⟧ detach op for slot ideation.
